arxiv-2012-01414.title: End-to-End QA on COVID-19: Domain Adaptation with Synthetic Training
arxiv-2012-01414.creator: Revanth Gangi Reddy, Bhavani Iyer, Md Arafat Sultan, Rong Zhang, Avi Sil, Vittorio Castelli, Radu Florian, Salim Roukos
arxiv-2012-01414.description: Abstract End-to-end question answering (QA) requires both information retrieval (IR) over a large document collection and machine reading comprehension (MRC) on the retrieved passages. Recent work has successfully trained neural IR systems using only supervised question answering (QA) examples from open-domain datasets.

arxiv-2106-12827.title: The gig economy in Poland: evidence based on mobile big data
arxiv-2106-12827.creator: Beręsewicz Maciej, Nikulin Dagmara, Szymkowiak Marcin, Wilak Kamil
arxiv-2106-12827.description: Abstract In this article we address the question of how to measure the size and characteristics of the platform economy. We propose a different, to sample surveys, approach based on smartphone data, which are passively collected through programmatic systems as part of online marketing.

arxiv-2204-11423.title: Trusted Multi-View Classification with Dynamic Evidential Fusion
arxiv-2204-11423.creator: Zongbo Han, Changqing Zhang, Huazhu Fu, Joey Tianyi Zhou
arxiv-2204-11423.description: Abstract Existing multi-view classification algorithms focus on promoting accuracy by exploiting different views, typically integrating them into common representations for follow-up tasks. Although effective, it is also crucial to ensure the reliability of both the multi-view integration and the final decision, especially for noisy, corrupted and out-of-distribution data.

arxiv-2304-00976.title: An Unbiased CO Survey Toward the Northern Region of the Small Magellanic Cloud with the Atacama Compact Array. II. CO Cloud Catalog Journal: ApJ CASA (v5.4.0; CASA Team et al. 2022 ), Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , APLpy ( Robitaille & Bressert 2012 )
arxiv-2304-00976.creator: Takahiro Ohno, Kazuki Tokuda, Ayu Konishi, Takeru Matsumoto, Marta Sewiło, Hiroshi Kondo, Hidetoshi Sano, Kisetsu Tsuge, Sarolta Zahorecz, Nao Goto, Naslim Neelamkodan, Tony Wong, Hajime Fukushima, Tatsuya Takekoshi, Kazuyuki Muraoka, Akiko Kawamura, Kengo Tachihara, Yasuo Fukui, Toshikazu Onishi
arxiv-2304-00976.description: Abstract The nature of molecular clouds and their statistical behavior in subsolar metallicity environments are not fully explored yet. We analyzed data from an unbiased CO( J J = 2–1) survey at the spatial resolution of ∼ \sim 2 pc in the northern region of the Small Magellanic Cloud with the Atacama Compact Array to characterize the CO cloud properties.

arxiv-2308-15871.title: Anomalous scaling corrections and quantum phase diagram of the Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the spatially anisotropic honeycomb lattice
arxiv-2308-15871.creator: Alexander Sushchyev, Stefan Wessel
arxiv-2308-15871.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alexander Sushchyev, Stefan Wessel. Using large-scale quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we determine the ground state phase diagram of the spin-1/2 antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on the honeycomb lattice for the most generic case of three varying interaction strengths along the different lattice directions. We identify continuous quantum phase transition lines that separate the long-range ordered antiferromagnetic regime from three distinct quantum-disordered phases, each characterized by dominant dimer-singlet formations.

arxiv-2409-09511.title: Explaining Deep Learning Embeddings for Speech Emotion Recognition by Predicting Interpretable Acoustic Features Thanks: DML was supported by a RallyPoint Fellowship and NIMH [5T32MH125815-03] and NIDCD training grants [5T32DC000038-28]. SSG was supported by a gift to the McGovern Institute for Brai
arxiv-2409-09511.creator: Satvik Dixit, Daniel M. Low, Gasser Elbanna, Fabio Catania, Satrajit S. Ghosh
arxiv-2409-09511.description: Abstract Pre-trained deep learning embeddings have consistently shown superior performance over handcrafted acoustic features in speech emotion recognition (SER). However, unlike acoustic features with clear physical meaning, these embeddings lack clear interpretability. Explaining these embeddings is crucial for building trust in healthcare and security applications and advancing the scientific understanding of the acoustic information that is encoded in them.

arxiv-2409-12810.title: Stability of the area preserving mean curvature flow in Asymptotic Schwarzschild space Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification. 51F99,31E05 Thanks: The third author is supported by NSFC No. 12071352, 12271039
arxiv-2409-12810.creator: Yaoting Gui, Yuqiao Li, Jun Sun
arxiv-2409-12810.description: Abstract . We first demonstrate that the area preserving mean curvature flow of hypersurfaces in space forms exists for all time and converges exponentially fast to a round sphere if the integral of the traceless second fundamental form is sufficiently small.

arxiv-2410-23395.title: Transcendentality of ABJM two-point functions
arxiv-2410-23395.creator: Marco S. Bianchi
arxiv-2410-23395.description: Abstract We compute the two-point function of protected dimension-1 operators in ABJM up to two loops in dimensional regularization. The result exhibits uniform transcendentality empirically, which we conjecture to hold at all orders. We leverage this property to streamline the reconstruction of the dimensional regularization expansion of master integrals in terms of bases of Euler sums of uniform transcendental weight.

arxiv-2501-05819.title: Diffusion Models for Smarter UAVs: Decision-Making and Modeling Thanks: Copyright (c) 2025 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. However, permission to use this material for any other purposes must be obtained from the IEEE by sending a request to pubs-permissions@ieee.org.
arxiv-2501-05819.creator: Yousef Emami, Hao Zhou
arxiv-2501-05819.description: Abstract Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly adopted in modern communication networks. However, challenges in decision-making and digital modeling continue to impede their rapid advancement. Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms face limitations such as low sample efficiency and limited data versatility, further magnified in UAV communication scenarios. Moreover, Digital Twin (DT) modeling introduces substantial decision-making and data management complexities.

arxiv-2509-25031.title: Bayesian Surrogates for Risk-Aware Pre-Assessment of Aging Bridge Portfolios
arxiv-2509-25031.creator: Sophia V. Kuhn, Rafael Bischof, Marius Weber, Antoine Binggeli, Michael A. Kraus, Walter Kaufmann, Fernando Pérez-Cruz
arxiv-2509-25031.description: Abstract Aging infrastructure portfolios pose a critical resource allocation challenge: deciding which structures require intervention and which can safely remain in service. Structural assessments must balance the trade-off between cheaper, conservative analysis methods and accurate but costly simulations that do not scale portfolio-wide.

pmc-10548420.title: Phosphine and Selenoether peri-Substituted Acenaphthenes and Their Transition-Metal Complexes: Structural and NMR Investigations
pmc-10548420.creator: Lutao Zhang, Francesca A. Christie, Anna E. Tarcza, Helena G. Lancaster, Laurence J. Taylor, Michael Bühl, Olga L. Malkina, J. Derek Woollins, Cameron L. Carpenter-Warren, David B. Cordes, Alexandra M. Z. Slawin, Brian A. Chalmers, Petr Kilian
pmc-10548420.description: A series of peri-substituted acenaphthene-based phosphine selenoether bidentate ligands Acenap(iPr2P)(SeAr) (L1–L4, Acenap = acenaphthene-5,6-diyl, Ar = Ph, mesityl, 2,4,6-trisopropylphenyl and supermesityl) were prepared. The rigid acenaphthene framework induces a forced overlap of the phosphine and selenoether lone pairs, resulting in a large magnitude of through-space 4JPSe coupling, ranging from 452 to 545 Hz.

pmc-11352657.title: Non-Invasive Assessment of Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease in Adolescents with Severe Obesity; Patient Characteristics and Association with Leptin—A Cross-Sectional Overview of Baseline Data from a RCT
pmc-11352657.creator: Fien de Boom, Ali Talib, Yvonne G. M. Roebroek, Givan F. Paulus, Ger H. Koek, Simon G. F. Robben, Bjorn Winkens, Nicole D. Bouvy, L. W. Ernest van Heurn
pmc-11352657.description: Background: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is the most common liver disease in adolescents with obesity. Nonetheless, the guidelines for screening and managing this disease are contradictory. The purpose of this study is to non-invasively assess the prevalence, patient characteristics, and potential associated factors of MASLD in this demographic.

pmc-11507073.title: Myo-Inositol and D-Chiro-Inositol Reduce DHT-Stimulated Changes in the Steroidogenic Activity of Adult Granulosa Cell Tumors
pmc-11507073.creator: Anna Maria Wojciechowska, Paulina Zając, Justyna Gogola-Mruk, Magdalena Karolina Kowalik, Anna Ptak
pmc-11507073.description: Considering the properties of myo-inositol (MI) and D-chiro-inositol (DCI), which are well known in polycystic ovary syndrome therapy, and the limitations of adult granulosa cell tumor (AGCT) treatment, especially for androgen-secreting tumors, we studied the role of MI and DCI in the androgen-rich environment of AGCTs.

pmc-11587129.title: Life Satisfaction After Burn Injury—A Comprehensive Review
pmc-11587129.creator: Maria Fernanda Hutter, Christian Smolle, Julia Kleinhapl, Lars-Peter Kamolz
pmc-11587129.description: Burn injuries can have long-lasting effects not only on a person’s bodily integrity but also on their psychosocial well-being. Since medical advancements have increased survival from burn injuries, improving psychosocial health has become a pivotal goal for burn rehabilitation. Besides health-related quality of life, life satisfaction has become an important parameter for evaluating long-term outcomes after burns.

pmc-11883207.title: Determinant factors of gross domestic product (GDP) in Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) member countries
pmc-11883207.creator: Faris Shafrullah, Leni Indrawati, Solahuddin Ismail, Faris Ihsan, Putri Ayu Pratiwi, Karno Karno, Justice Gameli Djokoto, Emre Gökçeli, Elistia Elistia, Ariodillah Hidayat, Tariq Hussain, Elistia Elistia, Leni Indrawati
pmc-11883207.description: BackgroundThe gross domestic product (GDP) of Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) member states can be used to determine their overall economic growth. In order to increase GDP, all emerging nations in Southeast Asia are stating to depend on foreign direct investment (FDI), the tourism industry, international visitors visiting ASEAN member nations banking credit, and low inflation rates.

pmc-12730610.title: HIV-Induced Apoptosis: Host Defense and Viral Strategy
pmc-12730610.creator: David Chisompola, Phinnoty Mwansa, John Nzobokela, Magdalene Ameka, Annet Kirabo, Antentor Hinton, Sepiso K. Masenga
pmc-12730610.description: Simple SummaryWhen the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infects a person, it triggers a process called apoptosis, a form of programmed cell death that is normally used by the body to eliminate damaged or infected cells. This review explores the double-edged role of this process in HIV infection.

pmc-13214085.title: Multi-parametric profiling of plasma-derived extracellular vesicles reveals a disease-associated molecular signature supporting a liquid biopsy approach in myelofibrosis
pmc-13214085.creator: Ghazal Narimanfar, Husam B. R. Alabed, Alessia Brancolini, Roberto Maria Pellegrino, Martina Barone, Claudia Venturi, Hillary Catellani, Giovanni Torsello, Luca Pestarino, Andrea Cavalli, Alessandra D’Addio, Alessia Tieghi, Regina Grillari-Voglauer, Francesca Palandri, Lucia Catani
pmc-13214085.description: BackgroundMyelofibrosis (MF) is a rare and severe myeloproliferative neoplasm characterized by bone marrow fibrosis, cytopenia, extramedullary hematopoiesis, and systemic inflammation. The tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a crucial role in MF pathogenesis by promoting fibrotic remodeling and supporting malignant clone survival.

pmc-13500474.title: Deep knowledge-driven multi-modal fusion for diagnosis and prognosis of SI-ARDS
pmc-13500474.creator: Hongyi Chen, Yang Gu, Guangwei Zhang, Yan Zhang, Xiaohui Duan, Ziying Li, Jiaqi Lin, Xiaoling Yi, Mansheng Chen, Tianqi Yang, Leqi Zheng, Xuanqi Huang, Guoqiong Zeng, Huijun Hu, Riyu Han, Hao Wu, Phei Er Saw, Peiyuan Lai, Li Li, Changdong Wang, Yunfang Yu, Tao Yu, Mohsen Guizani
pmc-13500474.description: BackgroundSepsis-Induced Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (SI-ARDS) presents significant diagnostic and prognostic challenges due to its complex clinical manifestations and high mortality rate.MethodsWe developed a deep Knowledge-Driven multi-Modal Fusion (KDMF) framework for the accurate diagnosis and prognosis of SI-ARDS. The model leverages multi-modal data, including CT images, CT reports, and laboratory indicators, alongside a disease-specific knowledge graph.

pmc-13640372.title: Individualized metabolic brain network alterations in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma: an 18F-FDG PET study
pmc-13640372.creator: Yelu Gu, Fan Yang, Hailun Zhang, Jingke Xiao, Jiangyan Liu
pmc-13640372.description: ObjectiveTo investigate cross-sectional differences in individualized metabolic brain network topology between patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) and healthy controls, and to explore the associations between network topology and cognitive performance.MethodsA total of 104 patients with DLBCL and 33 healthy controls were prospectively enrolled. All participants underwent whole-body 18F-FDG PET/CT between January 2024 and January 2026.
